description: Scheduled departure timetable at a Japanese train station (Tokyo Metro, JR East, Toei and other Japan railway operators): destination, departure time, train type and direction, for weekday/Saturday/holiday calendars. Resolve the station first with odpt_resolve_station to get its exact station_id (or pass a plain station name and this will resolve it for you, taking the first match). Needs an ODPT developer consumer key via _apiKey; Pipeworx supplies one if omitted. Example: odpt_station_timetable({ station: "Shinjuku", operator: "Tokyo Metro" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own ODPT developer consumer key. Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

calendar.description: Optional: keep only this calendar, e.g. "odpt.Calendar:Weekday" or "odpt.Calendar:SaturdayHoliday".

operator.description: Operator to search when `station` is a plain name and could match more than one operator, e.g. "Tokyo Metro".

railway.description: Optional: keep only this railway, e.g. "odpt.Railway:TokyoMetro.Marunouchi".

station.description: Station name (English or Japanese) or an exact odpt.Station id from odpt_resolve_station.

name: odpt_station_timetable
title: Odpt Station Timetable
